text: The call went echoing down the empty aisles and died out in the distance in a faint sound that resembled a ripple of mocking laughter. “Oh, don’t do it again, Tom, it is too horrid,” said Becky. “It is horrid, but I better, Becky; they might hear us, you know,” and he shouted again. The “might” was even a chillier horror than the ghostly laughter, it so confessed a perishing hope. The children stood still and listened; but there was no result.
